text: The file C:\Users\JohnHowes\.prelude\worktrees\258e60949d\prelude-design-workspace\prelude\design-workspace\NOTES.md has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

The pop-out has been designed and built. It's empty because of a one-line CSS bug.

**Why it's empty:** the design's styles sit inside `@scope (.design-page)`. One rule there tells the surface to fill the pop-out: `.window-page > .design { flex: 1; }`. In the pop-out, `.window-page` is the same element as the scope's root, `.design-page`. A plain selector inside `@scope` only matches elements *below* the root, so this rule never applies. The surface stays as tall as its bar. Below the bar, the frame has nothing to size itself from, so it shrinks to zero height. That's the empty dark area in your screenshot. The panel beside the chat works because its rules start from `.workspace`, which is inside the root.

**The fix** is `:scope.window-page > .design { flex: 1; }`.

- **Design (fixed):** I made the change in `prelude/design-workspace/styles.css:18`, so the design's own pop-out page is correct.
- **App (not fixed yet):** the running app uses its own copy of these styles, `server/public/workspace.css:25`. I can only edit files in the design's folder, so the app is still broken. It needs the same one-line change, through a build or a fix session.

I haven't checked this in a browser. The cause is plain from the code, and nothing else in the pop-out's markup looked wrong. I noted the bug and where the app needs the change in NOTES.md.
